description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kawarakkulama, Kuda Wewa, Pony Mankulama, Nuwaragam Palatha East D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110186
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules of land parcels with their extent, ownership details (all listed as "The State"), and title classifications. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
